item.title: MHI Expands Hydrolution EZY Series with New Heat Pump Models for Europe - Japan Industry News
item.description: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Thermal Systems, a division of Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Group, is expanding its Hydrolution EZY series of air-to-water heat pumps for the European market. The company has introduced new models with capacities of 10kW and 14kW, complementing the existing 6kW and 7.1kW units. These additions aim to meet diverse regional needs and will be released in European markets […]

item.title: Honda WN7 Electric Motorcycle Wins iF Design Gold Award - Japan Industry News
item.description: Honda's WN7 electric motorcycle has received the Gold Award in the Product Design discipline at the iF DESIGN AWARD, marking the first time a Honda product has achieved this honor. The iF DESIGN AWARD is one of the most prestigious design competitions globally, known for recognizing excellence in various design disciplines. item.description: Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India Pvt. Ltd. item.title: AEM Holdings and ASE Technology Forge Strategic Partnership for AI and HPC Market Expansion - Japan Industry News
item.description: AEM Holdings Ltd., a leader in test innovation, has announced a strategic partnership with ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd., the leading provider of semiconductor assembly, testing, and materials services. item.title: Hitachi Wins 2026 Catalyst Award for Workplace Inclusion Efforts - Japan Industry News
item.description: Hitachi, Ltd. item.title: Fujitsu's Traffic Simulation System Adopted in Maebashi City Plan - Japan Industry News
item.description: Fujitsu Limited has announced that its comprehensive traffic simulation system will be integrated into the Maebashi City Regional Public Transportation Plan. The system, developed under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism's COMmmmONS project, provides scientific evidence to support the plan's key measure of increasing bus routes. item.title: Eisai and Biogen Report High Persistence in Lecanemab Treatment for Alzheimer's - Japan Industry News
item.description: Eisai Co., Ltd. and Biogen Inc. have announced promising real-world findings on the long-term treatment persistence of their Alzheimer's drug, lecanemab. The analysis, presented at the 20th International Conference on Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s Diseases in Copenhagen, revealed that most patients continue treatment beyond the initial 18 months. item.title: Keio Plaza Hotel's 'Shoan' Tea Room to Reopen, Offering Cultural Experiences for Tourists - Japan Industry News
item.description: Keio Plaza Hotel Co., Ltd. is set to reopen its traditional Japanese tea ceremony room, 'Sho-fu-an,' on April 6, 2026, following extensive renovations. item.title: Fujitsu and Umios Complete Pilot for Seafood Traceability System - Japan Industry News
item.description: Fujitsu Limited and Umios Corporation have completed a pilot project for an electronic traceability system designed to track and visualize seafood distribution information. item.title: Hitachi Launches Plant-Based Lubricant to Reduce CO2 Emissions - Japan Industry News
item.description: Hitachi Industrial Equipment Systems Co., Ltd. has introduced a new plant-based lubricant, GREEN SCREW OIL, for oil-flooded screw air compressors, significantly cutting CO2 emissions during manufacturing. The lubricant, derived from plant materials that absorb CO2 through photosynthesis, reduces manufacturing-stage CO2 emissions by approximately 90% compared to conventional synthetic oils.
